findings.title: Conditional serializer hook misnamed, never called
findings.body: In app/serializers/user_serializer.rb the method is defined as `def include_website_name` without a trailing `?`. ActiveModel::Serializers looks for `include_website_name?` (as used for every other conditional attribute like `include_stats?`, `include_email?` in the same file), so this hook is never invoked. Consequence: `website_name` is always serialized even when `website` is blank, returning a null key, and any intended presence gating is bypassed.

findings.title: website_name bypasses TL0 anonymous hiding
findings.body: In app/serializers/user_serializer.rb `website` is listed in `untrusted_attributes` so it is suppressed for TL0 users viewed as anonymous via `restrict_user_fields?`, but the new `website_name` attribute is added to `attributes` without adding it to `untrusted_attributes` and its `include_website_name` check only tests `website.present?`. Consequence: an anonymous viewer who is correctly denied `website` still receives `website_name` (the host plus path for same-domain URLs), leaking the private profile field the restriction was meant to hide.
